entities.name: Monastery of Gix

entities.name: Flarg

events.summary: The Archmandrite invites Kathwar to join the Council of Mages.
events.quote: The Archmandrite of the Ivory Tower invited Kathwar , chief of the Malpiri clan, representing the Sardian people as well as the Malpiri, to join the Council of Mages .

events.summary: Malpiri is devastated during the Brothers' War.
events.quote: Like most nations of Terisiare , Malpiri was devastated during the Brothers' War .
